maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is insurance brokerage commissions and fees on policy placement and renewals, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private businesses, individuals and employers buying insurance and benefits; commissions come from commercial and personal premiums.

serial_acquirer.reason: Insurance brokerage that has grown through steady acquisitions of middle-market brokers, including O'Leary in Ireland, as its core strategy.

mission_critical.reason: Clients can move brokers at renewal, though insurance advice matters; switching is moderately easy, so not strongly locked in.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgment call; brokers are sticky through relationships but clients can change brokers at renewal.
